title: デビュー戦の後に・変われる1歩を

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Rice Shower takes her first step as a racer and makes her debut.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: A few days later, she watches one of Mihono Bourbon's races, who, despite debuting in the same year, is already drawing a lot of attention.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Seeing her bring smiles to so many people's faces inspires Rice Shower to run in the Classics.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: With the goal of catching up to Mihono Bourbon set firmly in her mind… she decides to run in the Spring Stakes as a warm-up for the Triple Crown.
